preferences.text: Reuse the user-approved Sleepyhead logos stored in the brand canvas registry and approved-logos/2026-10-15 archive instead of searching online again. Use the saved transparent orange-and-charcoal primary logo, or transparent white-and-charcoal reverse logo according to the scene. BOTH versions retain charcoal head, closed-eye e lower halves and TM: the reverse is not an all-white logo. Ensure contrast for every colour; do not place charcoal on an equally dark background or white lettering on white. Preserve exact shapes, two-tone colouring, spacing, trademark and proportions; never redraw. Original background versions are archived; use transparent derivatives when placing on artwork.
